# SD13-E5 Monk level 10 FOUR-bonus-feat fixture: the level-10 chassis fixture
# plus all four PF1 CRB bonus-feat selections ("At 1st level, 2nd level, and
# every 4 levels thereafter" = slots at 1/2/6/10). Slot 3 selects Improved
# Trip — a 6th-level LIST ADDITION, legal here and deliberately illegal at
# slots 1/2 (the list-correction slice); slot 4 selects Snatch Arrows, a
# 10th-level list addition. All four feats distinct. Chosen input only; no
# feat effect is computed.
# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 10 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1..level-9 martial chassis baseline to level 10 as chosen input only.
# It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus
# and bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/skill/equipment posture
# from the level-1 through level-9 fixtures, adding only the level bump this
# bounded tranche needs. The level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist)
# is carried forward unchanged — PF1 also grants monks SEPARATE bonus feats
# at 2nd and 6th level, but this slice deliberately does not add a new
# choice-slot for either (it stays named but unproven, unchanged by this
# widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of
# what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2/level-6/level-10
# repeat bonus-feat grant recognition, no ki-power execution (extra attack,
# AC bonus, or speed bonus), no ki-strike damage-reduction-bypass resolution
# (the level-10 "ki pool (lawful)" entry needs a DR/attack-resolution engine
# that does not exist in this codebase, so it stays named-but-unproven,
# mirroring the level-7 cold-iron/silver upgrade's own precedent), no
# fall-damage engine, no High Jump, no Wholeness of Body execution, and no
# level-11+ progression. The PF1 CRB Monk class table's level-10 "Special"
# column reads "Bonus feat, ki pool (lawful), slow fall 50 ft." (verified
# independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) — the only
# grounded change is Slow Fall's reach rising to 50 ft via the same
# grant-only identity record; the repeat bonus feat and the ki-lawful
# DR-bypass property both stay named-but-unproven.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level10-four-bonus-feats

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:10
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:deflect_arrows
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat_2:feat:combat_reflexes
